hints.title: Symmetric Character Pairing
hints.text: For a string to be a palindrome, characters at symmetric indices i and n - 1 - i must match.

hints.title: Lexicographical Tie Minimization
hints.text: Whenever characters at i and n - 1 - i differ, replace both with the alphabetically smaller character min(s[i], s[n - 1 - i]).

hints.title: Symmetric Inward Scan
hints.text: Iterate inward from both ends to the center, applying the minimum character replacement at each unequal pair.

hints.title: Inward Greedy Replacement Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass symmetric inward pointer scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 26 substitutions per position is exponential.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies greedy substitution with the smaller character at each mismatched symmetric pair.
